role: F: prospective phenomenological thermodynamic material model, not calibrated to a named chemical mixture
question: What happens to an initially uniform, intrinsically convex material mixture when ideal solutes reversibly associate and share reciprocal solubility interactions?

physical_law.free_energy: F=integral[alpha phi^2/2 + beta phi^4/4 + kappa |grad phi|^2/2 + sum_i c_i(log(c_i)-1+g_i) - chi phi(a+b+2c)] + integral[eta*(a+b+2c)^2/2]
physical_law.reaction: A+B <-> C; R=kf*a*b-kr*c; K=kf/kr; g_A=g_B=0, g_C=-log K
dynamics: c_i,t=-div J_i+stoichiometric reaction, J_i=-D c_i grad(mu_i)
physical_law.physical_interpretation: isothermal coarse-grained mixing/compressibility plus dilute-solute thermodynamics and reversible elementary association; phi is a conserved material-composition deviation, NOT a membrane variable
physical_law.parameter_mapping: dimensionless coefficients; no claim of identified molecules, experimentally verified phase boundaries, or microscopic derivation
physical_law.thermodynamic_requirement: F decreases; reaction entropy production R*log(K*a*b/c)>=0; a,b,c>0 without clipping
physical_law.heat_bath: RT=1, isothermal; heat dissipates to bath, total microscopic energy is not simulated
physical_law.repulsion_meaning: positive second-virial / compressibility term, per conserved building block; not a membrane, target geometry or phenotype
physical_law.boundedness: eta*n^2/2-chi*phi*n = eta/2*(n-chi*phi/eta)^2-chi^2*phi^2/(2eta); beta>0 therefore bounds F below independently of cell size. Ideal mixing terms also have a finite pointwise lower bound.

initial_conditions.phi: 0.01 RMS isotropic low-frequency noise, spatial mean zero
initial_conditions.solutes: spatially uniform, a=b=.5-c, c=(11-sqrt(21))/20; total A units and B units are .5 each; same concentrations for all cases
initial_conditions.material_interpretation_validity: coarse-grained order parameter; no inference of a literal bilayer or living cell

numerics.main: conservative Scharfetter-Gummel implicit line solves, exact local reaction substep, semi-implicit discrete-laplacian Fourier phase solve with subcycling if needed for numerical stability
numerics.locality_disclosure: PDE is local. Implicit line and Fourier inversions are computational shortcuts; this does not pass the strict local-explicit R0 gate. Independent explicit local short-time and exact-equilibrium tests required.
numerics.transport: Lagged nonideal chemical potential + implicit SG diffusion, with prospective free-energy rejection/subcycling if needed. Mass and positivity are never corrected. Check local small-dt limit and dt refinement.

verification.large_volume: L64 at matching dx if bounded regions do not fit with margin; independent noise at same physical bandwidth
verification.dimension_2: comparison only after 3D phase; never substitute for 3D

readouts: material variance, connected-region geometry and enclosed volume
reaction quotients and net reaction integrated inside and outside
building-block mass balances and F monotonicity

numerical_rejection.negative_concentration: any value below zero rejects; never clipped
numerical_rejection.F_increase: above roundoff rejects or subcycles before accepting numerical state

fixed_analysis.counting: Three genuinely distinct, controlled, reproducible physical changes are required. Textbook partition alone is validation, not a new finding. Conditional model observations must be labeled. No claim of life or a membrane from a density picture.

status: preregistered before v02 calculations; v01 outcomes never reused as v02 evidence
predecessor: v01 finite-grid pilot retained; continuum-collapse failure, see ../20261108-reactive-mixture/MODEL_LIMIT.json
model_scope_limit: Generic constitutive hypothesis, no named real molecule, no experimental phase-boundary validation; at most conditional physical-model observations, no formal R4 or life claim.
